# Comment Analysis

This layer is responsible for analyzing and processing comments in your codebase.

## Overview

The Comment Analysis layer processes comments to ensure they are accurate, relevant, and do not restate the code.

## Responsibilities

- **Accuracy Checks**: Ensures comments are accurate and relevant.

## Key components

| File | Purpose | Main definitions |
| --- | --- | --- |
| [`src/accuracy.js`](../src/accuracy.js) | Exports functions for accuracy checks and code analysis. | `ACCURACY_SCHEMA`, `attachedCode`, `buildAccuracyMessages`, `codeUnder`, `parseVerdicts` |
| [`src/analyze.js`](../src/analyze.js) | Works out per-line facts needed by the comment engine. | `analyzeLines`, `lineStarts`, `matchToken`, `splitLines`, `lineIndexAt`, `baseInfo` |
| [`src/comments.js`](../src/comments.js) | The comment engine. | `CATEGORY`, `LEVELS`, `RESPONSE_SCHEMA`, `applyProposals`, `buildWindows`, `checkComments` |
| [`src/owned.js`](../src/owned.js) | Which comments in a file Docturnal wrote itself. | `anchorHash`, `cleanRecords`, `findOwned`, `recordFor`, `isRecord` |
| [`src/python-helper.py`](../src/python-helper.py) | Analyzes and verifies Python source for Docturnal. | `analyze`, `dump`, `env_names`, `verify`, `main`, `_dotted` |
| [`src/python.js`](../src/python.js) | Runs src/python-helper.py with python3 to analyze and verify Python source. | `analyzePython`, `findPython`, `pythonEnvNames`, `verifyPython`, `runHelper` |
| [`src/report.js`](../src/report.js) | Builds .docturnal/last-run.md, which the GitHub App uses as the pull request description. | `DOCS_TITLE`, `UPDATE_TITLE`, `buildReport`, `code`, `plainText`, `progressLines` |
| [`src/restates.js`](../src/restates.js) | A deterministic check for comments that only restate the code under them. | `RESTATES_AT`, `restatement`, `restates`, `stem`, `words` |
| [`src/verify.js`](../src/verify.js) | Proves that inserting comments did not change the program. | `rebuildsOriginal`, `verifyCandidates`, `stripBom`, `rawLines`, `transpile`, `shape` |

## How it works

- **accuracy.js**: Provides functions for accuracy checks and code analysis.
- **analyze.js**: Determines per-line facts needed by the comment engine.
- **comments.js**: Implements the comment engine.
- **python-helper.py**: Analyzes and verifies Python source code.
- **python.js**: Runs the Python helper script to analyze and verify Python source.
- **report.js**: Builds a report for the GitHub App.
- **restates.js**: Checks for comments that restate the code.
- **verify.js**: Proves that inserting comments does not change the program.
